evidence: The commenter praises the flowers and reports converting the project into an Obsidian extension seeded by note filenames.

evidence_sources.author: ClaraForm
evidence_sources.excerpt: This is beautiful, thank you! I just asked Deepseek 4.1 Flash to convert it to an Obsidian extension that uses the file-name as the seed, and the result [1] is exactly something I've been dreaming of for so many years while I take daily notes.
